deferral_rationale: Reconciler r1 binding downgrade (workflow.yaml concerns_protocol.reconciler_special_case): tolerant per-row JSONL parse on all three legs is the approved plan v2's explicit design, not an implementation defect — plan 4.1 leg specs mandate the EXISTING tolerant readers (HEAD via _iter_jsonl_text, worktree via _iter_jsonl unchanged, ledger 'malformed lines skipped, count surfaced in the output'), the MF-3 core scopes leg errors to OPERATIONAL failures ('ANY operational failure is error'), and n_malformed IS surfaced (task_workflow.py:6350) exactly as specified. A persistent malformed row of the queried marker is a crash-truncated append whose post never returned success, so absent + re-post is the semantically correct recovery (the #1367 tail-seal makes the re-append land cleanly); the proposed nonzero-malformed=>unknown fix would permanently return rc 5 for every query on any task whose committed events.jsonl carries one historical partial line. The residual microsecond torn-read false-absent during a live >PIPE_BUF append is real but self-heals on the shipped delayed-re-read guidance and belongs to the same priced class as the plan's 12/assumption-11 double-failure residual; route as follow-up design observation via the plan's named Step-10 filing, never a round-1 code-review block.
